title: The Lid on the Raisin Jar
youtube_title: The Lid on the Raisin Jar | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Dahlia wants to check on a raisin jar with the loose tin lid before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Dahlia leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
